Exclusions are sequential and mutually exclusive: boundary, then radius among boundary-valid people, then neighbour count among boundary-and-radius-valid people. Each stack totals 2164. Marginal radius/local-count validity fields are not treated as a sequential funnel.
panels.uncertainty: None
panels.display_transform: Exact source counts; no new support rule or eligibility filtering.

panels.estimator: Fixed-model responses to score changes −2, −1, 0, +1, +2 on the common support set for all five settings. Joining segments connect discrete evaluated settings and do not establish a smooth dose-response relationship.
panels.uncertainty: Saved pointwise 95% participant-bootstrap intervals.

panels.estimator: Pooled fixed-model responses to one-point decrements/increments under minimum-neighbour counts 5, 10, 20. Eligible participants differ by threshold; axis labels report n. Source rows with insufficient support remain unestimated and are explicitly labelled; no zero effect is imputed. This changes the support population, not only a numerical tuning value.
panels.uncertainty: Saved pointwise 95% participant-bootstrap intervals.
